title: Prescribed-qbot convergence attribution
question: Is the one-extra-iteration prescribed-qbot path caused by conductivity approximation rather than by the derivative-consistent retention/capacity representation?
variants: decoupled theta/C interpolant plus K lookup at abs logK <=3e-4
same derivative-consistent theta/C interpolant plus exact analytical K
decision_rule: Attribute K as convergence-controlling only if exact K restores the analytical iteration and backtracking counts while preserving the already-small state and mass differences.
